headline: Sales growth accelerates but costs erase the gain
summary_short: Chipotle's Q2 2026 revenue rose 9.3% y/y to $3,348.6M on 2.2% comparable-sales growth, but operating income fell 6.0% to $525.6M and net income dropped 7.5% to $403.5M as cost inflation and higher G&A outweighed the top-line gain; diluted EPS held flat at $0.32 on buybacks.
summary_long: Revenue grew 9.3% y/y to $3,348.6M on 2.2% comparable-sales growth (1.2ppt average check, 1.0ppt transactions) plus new-restaurant contribution. Food/beverage/packaging rose 0.8ppt of revenue on beef/freight inflation; labor rose 0.3ppt on wage inflation; G&A rose $18.3M on bonuses, legal contingencies, and wages, partly offset by lower retention-award stock comp. Operating income fell 6.0% to $525.6M; with interest income down 58.2% and a 24.3% tax rate, net income fell 7.5% to $403.5M. Diluted EPS held flat at $0.32 as a ~5.3% share-count reduction from buybacks offset the income decline. Cash fell to $228.2M on $1.35B of YTD buybacks. No FY2026 guidance was given; management flagged comp-sales headwinds that could worsen into Q3 2026.

drivers.explanation: Comparable restaurant sales rose 2.2% (1.2ppt from average check, 1.0ppt from transactions), plus $66.0M from restaurants opened in 2026 and $161.9M from restaurants opened in 2025 not yet in the comparable base.
The 2.2% increase reflects a 1.2% rise in average check (1.6% menu pricing partly offset by a 0.4% negative check-mix shift) and a 1.0% rise in transactions.

Food/beverage/packaging costs rose 0.8ppt of revenue on beef and freight inflation plus higher protein/produce usage; labor rose 0.3ppt on wage inflation; G&A rose $18.3M on bonuses, legal contingencies, and wages, partly offset by lower retention-award stock comp.

The operating-income decline compounded with a 58.2% drop in interest and other income (fewer interest-bearing securities held after continued share repurchases), leaving pretax income down 7.6% before a 24.3% effective tax rate.
Net income fell 7.5% but weighted-average diluted shares fell roughly 5.3% (1,350.2M to 1,279.1M) on continued buybacks, leaving diluted EPS unchanged at $0.32.
Cash fell as $1,354.9M of YTD share repurchases and $397.6M of YTD capex outpaced $1,332.0M of operating cash flow.
Equity declined as $1,331.6M of YTD stock repurchases (retired, not held as treasury stock) exceeded $706.4M of YTD net income.

Management attributes sales strength to its 'Recipe for Growth' strategy against a dynamic consumer environment, while flagging recent low-single-digit comparable-sales headwinds tied to food-safety concerns and geopolitical developments that could worsen in Q3 2026.
